payload.title: First real publish and visibility check (#1, #3)
payload.objective: See a post approved in Noon Gun go out to a real Facebook Page at its scheduled minute, and find out who can see it while the Meta app is in Development mode.
successCriteria: An approved post is published at its scheduled minute and shows its permalink
Visibility from a signed-out browser in Development mode is recorded
What Live mode requires is recorded in docs/platform-notes/meta.md
Photo posts and deletion through the API are tried or explicitly deferred
